android.shortDescription: Native tools for everyday tasks, with web-only tools opening in your browser.
android.fullDescription:
enV brings native tools for everyday tasks together in one app.

Use supported native utilities for calculations, conversions, date and time tasks, QR and barcode scanning, file workflows, business tasks and developer utilities. Each tool has its own inputs, options and result checks.

enV is a native Android app, not a WebView wrapper. When you select a tool that is only available in enV Web, the app opens that tool separately in your system browser. The native app keeps its own screens and navigation.

Processing depends on the selected tool. Some operations run on your device; tools that use connected services need an internet connection. Review the notice and options on the individual tool before submitting information.

Use enV to complete supported tasks, inspect results and decide how to save or share the output.
